_README: quetrex-factory — MANAGED SETTINGS (the mandatory org floor).
WHAT THIS IS: the highest-precedence Claude Code settings tier. Values here
CANNOT be overridden, weakened, or removed by any user ~/.claude/settings.json,
project .claude/settings.json, plugin settings, CLI flag, or environment. It is
the mechanical guarantee behind the four pillars — no teammate can silently
disable the verify-gate, the secret/destructive-command guards, or the merge gate,
not even under --dangerously-skip-permissions (a blocking PreToolUse hook and a
permission deny-LIST both precede permission-mode grants).
HOW TO DEPLOY: this file is NOT read from the repo. An org admin installs it via
the Team/Enterprise managed-settings channel so it lands at the OS managed path
on every developer machine and every cloud session:
macOS   : /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json
Linux   : /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json
Windows : C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json
Team/Enterprise admins push it from the admin console (or MDM); it is enforced
identically in local runs AND in cloud/remote sessions. This repo copy is the
source of truth the admin publishes — edits here take effect only after the admin
re-publishes. There is no per-project way to grant or bypass anything set below.
AUTO MODE: the team runs permission-mode 'auto' (a blocking hook fires first, then
allow rules apply; prompts only for the residual). defaultMode:'auto' is HONORED
ONLY in the user settings tier and (as here) the managed tier — it is IGNORED in
project and plugin settings since v2.1.142. Because a project/plugin cannot grant
auto, the team default is set HERE (managed) so every developer and cloud session
gets auto without each person editing their own ~/.claude/settings.json. A user may
still choose a STRICTER mode locally; they can never drop below this floor.
PLUGIN PIN: strictKnownMarketplaces + enabledPlugins force the single trusted
marketplace (github: Glori-Holdings/quetrex-plugins, private) and force-enable
quetrex-factory. No other marketplace can be added and the engine plugin cannot be
turned off. allowManagedHooksOnly:true means ONLY managed-tier and plugin-declared
hooks execute — ad-hoc hooks injected via user/project settings.json are ignored,
so a teammate cannot register a hook that shadows or neutralizes the floor.
The ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} in the hook commands resolves to the installed
quetrex-factory plugin root (force-enabled above), so the floor hooks run the same
audited scripts the plugin ships — one source of truth, no divergent copies.
